citation.title: A dimensionless criterion for characterizing internal transport barriers in JET
citation.authors: G. Tresset, X. Litaudon, D. Moreau, X. Garbet and Contributors to the EFDA-JET Work Programme
citation.doi_or_arxiv: unknown (PII S0029-5515(02)36315-4; DOI not stated in supplied text)

topic: Offline local ITB detection on JET using rho*_T = rho_s/L_T computed from ECE Te or CX Ti profiles, with an uncertainty-based confidence factor.
own_question: Can a single dimensionless threshold identify the onset, location and evolution of ITBs across varied JET discharges?
actual_method_and_evidence: rho*_T was computed from three-point logarithmic temperature gradients, with Gaussian error propagation assuming about 5% uncertainties. A threshold of about 1.4e-2 was tuned on reference discharge 48993. The criterion was then compared on 116 deuterium OS discharges, 84 of which had ITBs, against manual identification. The paper reports 5 weak barriers missed, 1 unconfirmed detection, onset-time uncertainty of about 150 ms and location error of 4.7 cm. There was no held-out split. The E×B interpretation is presented as heuristic dimensional analysis, partly illustrated with fluid simulations.
input_target_timing_if_relevant: Offline profile analysis; real-time ITB control is mentioned only as an application in cited work. It does not nowcast reports, does not use BES/ECEI, and its CX Ti is charge-exchange Ti (carbon force balance is discussed for Er).
validation_if_relevant: Threshold set on one reference shot, then compared to the authors' own manual analysis within the same database; not independent truth.
forbidden_inferences: Not evidence for CES nowcasting or for BES/ECEI incremental information.
Does not establish a KSTAR pedestal-top threshold.
The E×B mechanism was not demonstrated.
Its real-time use was not shown in this paper.
reason_to_include_or_exclude: Concerns core ITB characterization on JET rather than causal temporal estimation of pedestal CES reports. At most, it could be cited as background that gradient-based dimensionless indicators were proposed for real-time-friendly ITB identification; otherwise exclude.
source_scope_note: All extracted page texts supplied; figure/equation visual validation remains separate
